summary: BI-FC5E4832 (EP-0237A305, knowledge-linking spec §4.3). Migration 20261114000000_wiki_page_body_trgm_index adds WikiPage_body_trgm_idx, a GIN trigram index on WikiPage.body, so the wiki page's unlinked-mentions lookup (body ILIKE per mention term) can use an index instead of a sequential scan as the wiki grows.
affectedCopies: WikiPage: no column, constraint or row changes. One new secondary index on body; Postgres maintains it on every insert and update of a page body.

privacyAssessment.sensitivity: internal: an index over existing wiki page bodies, readable only through the same organization-scoped queries as the table itself.
privacyAssessment.dataSubjectRights: No new data. Deleting or editing a page updates the index with it.
privacyAssessment.reviewDisposition: Derived access structure; it lives and dies with the WikiPage rows it indexes.

migration.name: 20261114000000_wiki_page_body_trgm_index
migration.backfill: None. CREATE INDEX builds from existing rows (about 1 MB at 385 pages on the dev install).
migration.rollback: Forward-only and additive. DROP INDEX "WikiPage_body_trgm_idx" returns the lookup to a sequential scan with identical results.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Unchanged: wiki pages keep their existing lifecycle. This change adds a secondary index only.

fields.reason: Existing field, now also indexed with gin_trgm_ops. No new data and no change to who can read it.
